requiredBehaviour: scrypt, per-password salt, constant-time compare, cost encoded in the hash, transparent rehash on login
evidence: npm test :: 'password hashing: correct verifies, wrong does not, hashes are salted'; 'weaker stored parameters are detected for rehash'

requiredBehaviour: wrong password is refused with a uniform 401 and issues no cookie
evidence: npm test :: 'login with the wrong password is 401'; live curl 401; browser login shows the server message

requiredBehaviour: an unknown address is indistinguishable from a wrong password, in message and in timing
evidence: npm test :: 'sign-in for an unknown address fails the same way'; equivalentWork() burns one scrypt

requiredBehaviour: 8 consecutive failures lock the account for 15 minutes, then it unlocks
evidence: npm test :: 'repeated failures lock the account, and the lock expires'

requiredBehaviour: revoked, expired, idle and suspended-user sessions all stop resolving immediately
evidence: npm test :: 'sessions: revoked, expired and idle sessions all stop resolving'; 'suspending a user invalidates live sessions immediately'

requiredBehaviour: httpOnly, SameSite=lax, Secure in production; only the SHA-256 is stored
evidence: npm test :: 'only the token hash is stored, never the token'; browser document.cookie does not contain the session

requiredBehaviour: single-use token, expiry enforced, all sessions revoked on reset, unknown address reveals nothing
evidence: npm test :: 'password reset consumes its token once, works, and ends every session'; 'an expired reset token is refused'

requiredBehaviour: protected endpoints refuse anonymous and forged cookies regardless of the frontend
evidence: npm test :: 'PROTECTED: business endpoints refuse an anonymous request'; 'a forged cookie value does not authenticate'; live curl 401

requiredBehaviour: the tenant comes from the session; naming another tenant id is refused; another tenant's record is 404 not 403
evidence: npm test :: 'ISOLATION: a session cannot bind to a tenant it has no membership in'; 'ISOLATION: leads never cross tenants, by list or by id'

requiredBehaviour: cross-tenant update and archive are refused and leave the target untouched
evidence: npm test :: 'ISOLATION: removing a membership in another tenant is refused'

requiredBehaviour: server-side role check; a viewer cannot write whatever the UI shows
evidence: npm test :: 'a viewer is refused a write by the server, whatever the UI shows'; 'a viewer may read but not write'

requiredBehaviour: a workspace cannot lose its last owner; the owner rows are locked during the check
evidence: npm test :: 'a workspace cannot lose its last owner by demotion or removal'

requiredBehaviour: invitation row and its delivery are enqueued in one transaction; acceptance is single-use; expiry is enforced and recorded
evidence: npm test :: 'inviting queues delivery in the same transaction and records audit'; 'accepting an invitation ... cannot be replayed'; 'an expired invitation is refused and marked expired'

requiredBehaviour: actor taken from the session, append-only, secrets redacted at any depth
evidence: npm test :: 'every mutation writes an audit row with the real actor'; 'audit detail redacts secrets even when a caller passes them'

requiredBehaviour: duplicate effects collapse on an idempotency key; leases, backoff and a dead-letter state; expired leases are released
evidence: npm test :: 'outbox: an identical effect is enqueued once'; 'claim, deliver, and retry with a dead letter at the end'; 'an expired lease is released for another dispatcher'

requiredBehaviour: one claim per job under concurrency; a late result from a superseded worker is rejected; checkpoints resume
evidence: npm test :: 'a job is claimed once, even by two workers racing'; 'FENCING: a late result from a superseded worker is rejected'; 'checkpoints survive so a bounded step resumes'

requiredBehaviour: exponential backoff to a bounded dead-letter; every attempt recorded
evidence: npm test :: 'failures back off, then dead-letter instead of retrying forever'

requiredBehaviour: exactly one job per occurrence even with two dispatchers; repeated dispatch is a no-op
evidence: npm test :: 'a due schedule creates exactly one job per occurrence, even across two dispatchers'; 'running the dispatcher twice ... does not double-create'

requiredBehaviour: local time tracked across DST; a non-existent local time still runs; an ambiguous one runs once
evidence: npm test :: 'a local 09:00 tracks the zone across DST'; 'spring forward: a job at a local time that does not exist still runs'; 'fall back: an hourly job runs once per real hour'

requiredBehaviour: a long outage records missed occurrences instead of firing a burst; overlap policy is honoured
evidence: npm test :: 'a long outage records missed runs rather than firing a burst'; 'overlap policy skip records a missed occurrence'

requiredBehaviour: applied once in a transaction, checksummed; editing a shipped migration is an error; re-run is a no-op
evidence: npm test :: 'a fresh database applies every migration'; 're-running migrations is a no-op'; 'editing an already-applied migration is refused'

requiredBehaviour: numeric(18,4) plus an explicit currency; no float anywhere in the money path
evidence: npm test :: 'money survives the round trip exactly — no float drift' (0.1 + 0.2 + 19.9999 = 20.2999)

requiredBehaviour: one envelope with code, message, per-field errors, request id and conflict version; unknown fields rejected; malformed body is 400 not a crash
evidence: npm test :: 'register rejects unknown fields rather than ignoring them'; 'a malformed body is a 400, not a crash'; live curl 422 'Unknown field: isAdmin'

requiredBehaviour: durable typed records; survive server restart and a new browser; list/count/filter agree
states: loading refreshing empty filtered-empty error denied retry
evidence: npm test :: 'the total reflects the filter'; 'pagination does not repeat or drop rows'; live: created via curl, rendered in the browser, created in the browser, read back via API after a server restart

requiredBehaviour: relationships are foreign keys, not display-name strings; one organisation per name per tenant
evidence: npm test :: 'a lead creates its person and organisation as linked records, not name strings'; 'two leads at the same company share one organisation record'

requiredBehaviour: a stale version is a 409 carrying the current version; the first edit survives
evidence: npm test :: 'CONFLICT: a stale version is refused and reports the current one'

requiredBehaviour: conversion preserves the lead and links the deal; cannot be repeated; stage history recorded
evidence: npm test :: 'conversion creates a deal, keeps the lead, and records the stage move'; 'a lead cannot be converted twice'

requiredBehaviour: archive hides from the default list and is reversible; history is never destroyed
evidence: npm test :: 'archive hides from the default list, restore brings it back, history is kept'

requiredBehaviour: no fabricated identity; the control states that SSO is unconfigured
evidence: browser: buttons disabled with 'Single sign-on is not configured on this deployment yet.'

requiredBehaviour: a production executor for work exceeding one request
blockedBy: D1 — execution platform (App Runner eligibility / Vercel plan / ECS)
evidence: queue, leases, fencing, retries and the cron engine are implemented and tested against a local worker; only the remote adapter is blocked
